Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Public creator bio link page and storefront configuration keyed by unique username.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

username.description: Unique public URL slug for the profile (3-24 lowercase chars, digits, dot, hyphen).

name.description: Display name shown on the public profile.

bio.description: Short biography text shown under the display name.

avatar.description: Firebase Storage HTTPS URL for the profile hero/avatar image.

avatarOffsetY.description: Vertical focal position percentage (0-100) for the hero image.

avatarScale.description: Zoom scale factor (0.5-3.0) for the hero image.

socials.description: Map of social links (instagram, tiktok, whatsapp, telegram, youtube, facebook, linkedin, discord).

links.description: Ordered list of custom link capsules shown in the Ev tab (max 50).

products.description: Ordered list of products shown in the Magaza tab (max 50).

music.description: Ordered list of Mixtape audio tracks shown in the Ev tab (max 30).

news.description: Ordered list of media/info cards shown in the Ev carousel (max 20).

wa.description: Owner WhatsApp phone digits used for direct Sifaris order buttons.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private user account mapping Firebase UID to claimed username and email.

email.description: Private user email address (PII - strictly owner/admin read only).

/profiles/{username}.description: Publicly gettable creator bio link and shop documents keyed by unique lowercase username.

/users/{uid}.description: Private UID-to-username ownership mapping and email PII strictly isolated to owner and admin.
